verdict.rationale: Carta handles sensitive customer data and ships AI plugins (an MCP server that gives LLMs access to cap table and fund data), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any control, setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The community reports about cap table data being used for sales outreach concern a different issue and do not bear on AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
